# ANALYSIS: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on top 3 J days

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  

## Hypothesis  

The STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND veto (blocking P-in-uptrend / C-in-downtrend) should preserve all three J anchor PUT winners while removing wrong-way bear PUT entries that occur during confirmed 5m uptrends, thereby improving robustness without hurting edge_capture.  

## Mechanism  

Walk-forward OOS: split the full OPRA period (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) into rolling 8-month train / 4-month test windows, stepping monthly. For each window, re-run the engine with the veto enabled/disabled and compute edge_capture on the J anchor days that fall in the test window. Real-fills validation: re-play the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) through the realistic OPRA simulator (cached bid/ask, slippage model) with the veto enabled and compare P&L to baseline.

Walk-forward OOS aggregate Sharpe: 4.728 vs baseline 4.340 (+9%). MaxDD unchanged (−2,273). Real-fills A/B full-period P&L: +7,555 → +8,138 (+$583). The veto removes 2 wrong-way LOSERS net −$574 (bear PUTs into confirmed 5m uptrend on 06-26) with zero impact on winners.  

## OP-20 disclosures (for candidate)  

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.  
2. **Sample bias:** Sample = full OPRA 2025-01-02..2026-06-18 (16 months). Selection = all days; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS and guard tests.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** Walk-forward OOS positive (Sharpe +9%, 0/6 quarters negative).  
4. **Real-fills:** Real-fills A/B shows +$583 improvement; top-3 J days unchanged (result: no delta on anchor days).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/04 extreme vol day still preserved (RANGE=no-veto). Max drawdown unchanged. Blow-up scenario: if veto misclassifies trend, could block winners; guard shows no winner blocked.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (top-5 days P&L share not provided in leaderboard).
